headline: Create Account & Sign In, from entry to detail
overview:
Inner Quest lets you create an account in seconds using either your email or Google account. Once signed in, you unlock the full experience — your progress is tracked, your data syncs across devices, and you get a personalized home page with daily gratitude prompts, an AI guide, and progress stats.

You can also explore the app as a guest without creating an account, but signing up ensures your journey is saved and your insights build over time.
targetAudience: New users visiting Inner Quest for the first time who want to create an account to start their self-discovery journey, or returning users who need to sign back in.

steps.title: Sign Up Page — Choose Your Method
steps.description:
Navigate to /signup (or tap "Get Started" from the home page) to see the account creation form. You have two options:

1. **Continue with Google** — one-tap signup using your Google account. Your name and profile photo are imported automatically.
2. **Email & Password** — enter your name, email, and a password (minimum 6 characters).

At the bottom, you'll also find links to sign in if you already have an account, or continue as a guest.
steps.screenshotAlt: Sign up page showing Continue with Google button and email registration form with Name, Email, and Password fields

steps.title: Fill In Your Details
steps.description:
Enter your name, email address, and choose a password. The password must be at least 6 characters. Your name will be used to greet you throughout the app and personalize your experience.

Once everything is filled in, tap the purple "Create Account" button to register.
steps.screenshotAlt: Sign up form filled with name and email, password masked, ready to submit
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Welcome Home — Your Journey Begins
steps.description:
After creating your account, you're immediately taken to your personalized home page. Here you'll see:

- A **greeting** with your name and an inspirational quote of the day
- **Today's Gratitude** — a daily prompt with space to write three things you're grateful for
- **AI Guide** — your personal AI assistant ready to help you explore the app
- **Progress Dashboard** — tracks your total activities, active days, tools used, and overall journey progress
- **Continue Your Journey** — quick links to recommended tools like Growth Tracker, Breathing Practice, and Wolf Reflection

Everything starts at zero — as you use the app, your dashboard fills up with meaningful data.
steps.screenshotAlt: Authenticated home page showing Good morning greeting, Today's Gratitude prompt, and AI Guide section
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Sign In — Returning Users
steps.description:
If you already have an account, navigate to /signin (or tap "Sign In" from the sign up page). The sign in page offers the same two methods:

1. **Continue with Google** — one tap if you signed up with Google
2. **Email & Password** — enter your registered email and password

You can also create a new account from here, or continue browsing as a guest.
steps.screenshotAlt: Sign in page showing Welcome Back heading, Google sign-in button, and email/password form
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

keyFeatures: Two sign-up methods: Google OAuth and email/password
Instant account creation with no email verification required
Anonymous guest access for exploring before committing
Automatic profile sync — name and photo imported from Google
Account linking — upgrade from guest to full account without losing data
Personalized home page immediately after signup
Privacy-first design — your data stays yours
tips: Google sign-up is the fastest — one tap and you're in with your name and photo imported
If you started as a guest, you can link your account later without losing any progress
Use a strong password — minimum 6 characters, but longer is better
Your first stop after signing up should be the gratitude prompt on your home page
Check out the AI Guide on the home page if you're not sure where to start
